summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop per-site pages: sites ~21 -> 22 (801-822, all basic drive-in, 40-80 ft, 3 pull-throughs); confirmed no electric (and no water/sewer), reservation-only on cpwshop; added year-round season (801-806 winter, 807-822 close Nov 1), url/window 180/fcfs never/14-night max. Fees ($28 basic, CPW page agrees) and facilities (vault toilets, hand pumps, dump stated park-wide) left as stored. Note: dropped the site-count/amenity/booking restatements and 'Camp Colorado'.
flags: Waterfront (stored lakefront): cpwshop tags all 22 Witchers Cove sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront', agreeing with the stored value. On Esri imagery the loop runs along the south shore of a cove on open grass with no tree screen; the shoreline sites (801-812, 817-822) sit roughly 25-100 m from the waterline in that image, the inner sites 813-816 about 100-170 m. The imagery date/pool level is unknown, so whether the high-water shore reaches the aprons is not established here; no contrary claim.
Pin 38.9056,-105.496 sits at the east end of the loop by site 801, ~320 m from the 22-site centroid (38.90624,-105.49963); the loop spans ~900 m along the shore, so within tolerance.
Phone 719-748-3401 is the park's (not re-read this pass; the CPW pages give reservations as 1-800-244-5613).
